        • currentState

          HairDryerImplementationI.HairDryerState currentState
          current state (OFF, ON) of the hair dryer.

        • currentMode

          HairDryerImplementationI.HairDryerMode currentMode
          current mode (LOW, HIGH) of the hair dryer.

        • consumptionHasChanged

          boolean consumptionHasChanged
          true when the electricity consumption of the dryer has changed after executing an external event; the external event changes the value of currentState and then an internal transition will be triggered by putting through in this variable which will update the variable currentIntensity.

          power consumption in the LOW mode in the power unit defined by the hair dryer.

          power consumption in the HIGH mode in the power unit defined by the hair dryer.

        • totalConsumption

          double totalConsumption
          total consumption of the hair dryer during the simulation in kwh.

          fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.hioa.models.vars.Value<Type> currentIntensity
          current intensity in the power unit defined by the electric meter.
